<!doctype html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>법정대리인 동의서 - 웹 작성용</title><style>
:root { color-scheme: light; font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo',Arial,sans-serif; --ink:#152b46; --muted:#50617a; --blue:#1766d1; --border:#d9e2ed; --page-w:794px; }
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body { margin:0; background:#edf2f8; color:var(--ink); }
.topbar { display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;background:#fff;padding:18px clamp(15px,3.5vw,35px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
h1 {font-size:clamp(20px,2.1vw,28px);margin:0;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.small-header{font-size:13px;color:#586782;margin-top:6px}
.actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
button,.file-button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #c5d3e4;padding:10px 13px;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;font-weight:650;display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
button:hover,.file-button:hover {background:#eef5ff;border-color:#8ab3e5}
.primary {background:#1d65c5;border-color:#1d65c5;color:#fff}
.primary:hover{background:#1257b0;color:#fff}
.print-status{font-size:12px;flex-basis:100%;font-weight:600;color:#28603c;min-height:0}
button:disabled{cursor:wait;opacity:.67}
.layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(305px,390px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px;align-items:start;padding:20px;max-width:1650px;margin:0 auto}
.sidebar{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:19px;max-height:calc(100vh - 145px);overflow:auto;position:sticky;top:13px;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(10,33,80,.045)}
.notice{border-left:3px solid #317bdc;background:#f2f7fd;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#3c526d}
.notice strong{color:#15345c}
fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:18px 0 22px}
legend {font-size:15px;font-weight:750;border-bottom:1px solid #dce6f1;width:100%;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.field{margin:10px 0 14px}
.field label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;margin-bottom:5px;color:#253955}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;height:39px;border:1px solid #c3d1e1;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;color:#16263a;outline-offset:2px}
.field textarea{height:65px;resize:vertical}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:#1766d1;outline:2px solid #abcfff}
.hint{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#677a94;line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px}
.doc-area{min-width:0}
.guide{font-size:13px;color:#566781;line-height:1.7;padding:0px 6px 10px}
.paper-shell {width:min(794px,100%);height:auto;aspect-ratio:794/1122;position:relative;margin:0 auto 18px;filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 15px rgba(26,42,64,.17))}
.paper {position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:794px;height:1122px;transform:scale(var(--scale,1));transform-origin:top left;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.paper img {width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:fill;display:block;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.overlay {position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.page-fill {position:absolute;color:#111;line-height:1.15;font-family:'Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR',Arial,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none}
.page-char {transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-weight:500;text-align:center}
.page-mark {transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-weight:850;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;}
.page-line {transform:translateY(-50%);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:clip}
.page-wrap {white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.32;transform:none}
.page-footer {text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#6b7b91;margin-top:10px}
@media(max-width:1000px){.layout{display:block;padding:14px}.sidebar{position:static;max-height:none;margin-bottom:22px}.doc-area{max-width:800px;margin:auto}}
@media print {
 @page{size:A4 portrait;margin:0}
 html,body{background:#fff !important;margin:0;padding:0}
 .topbar,.sidebar,.guide,.page-footer{display:none !important}
 .layout,.doc-area{display:block!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;max-width:none!important}
 .paper-shell {display:block;width:210mm!important;height:297mm!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;filter:none!important;break-after:page;page-break-after:always}
 .paper-shell:last-child{break-after:auto;page-break-after:auto}
 .paper {width:210mm!important;height:297mm!important;transform:none!important;position:relative}
 .paper img {print-color-adjust:exact;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact}
 .page-fill{print-color-adjust:exact;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact}
}
</style><style>.kin-home{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none;background:#eaf2ff;color:#245597;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;margin:8px 0 0;white-space:nowrap}@media print{.kin-home{display:none!important}}</style></head>
<body><a class="kin-home" href="../index.html">← KIN THE USA · 전체 도구로</a><header class="topbar"><div><h1>법정대리인 동의서</h1><div class="small-header">별지 제1호의2서식 (원본 1페이지)</div></div><div class="actions"><button type="button" onclick="downloadJSON()">💾 작성내용 저장</button><button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('jsonFile').click()">📂 불러오기</button><button type="button" onclick="clearValues()">초기화</button><button type="button" onclick="doPrint()">🖨️ 인쇄하기</button><button id="downloadPdfButton" type="button" class="primary" onclick="exportPDF()">📄 PDF 다운로드</button><input type="file" id="jsonFile" accept=".json,application/json" hidden onchange="loadJSON(this)"></div><div id="actionStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite" class="print-status"></div></header>
<main class="layout"><section class="sidebar" aria-label="편집 양식"><div class="notice"><strong>브라우저에서 입력 → 오른쪽 원본에 자동 반영</strong><br>부모가 공동친권자인 경우 서식의 유의사항에 따라 부모 모두의 동의가 필요합니다.<br>외부 서버로 전송되지 않습니다. <b>작성내용 저장</b>은 개인정보가 포함된 JSON 파일이므로 안전하게 보관하세요.</div><fieldset><legend>신청인 (여권 명의인 · 자녀)</legend><div class="field"><label for="f-child_name">자녀 성명</label><input type="text" id="f-child_name" data-field="child_name" autocomplete="off" maxlength="40"></div><div class="field"><label for="f-child_id">자녀 주민등록번호</label><input type="text" id="f-child_id" data-field="child_id" autocomplete="off" maxlength="14" placeholder="예: 123456-1234567" inputmode="text" pattern="[0-9]{6}-?[0-9]{7}"><span class="hint">하이픈을 포함해 입력할 수 있습니다. 숫자만 입력해도 자동으로 하이픈이 붙습니다.</span></div><div class="field"><label for="f-child_address">자녀 주소</label><textarea id="f-child_address" data-field="child_address" autocomplete="off" maxlength="180" placeholder="미국 주소 포함 실제 주소를 기재" rows="2"></textarea></div></fieldset><fieldset><legend>동의 구분</legend><div class="field"><label for="f-consent_type">동의 내용</label><select id="f-consent_type" data-field="consent_type" autocomplete="off"><option value="">선택하세요</option><option value="발급">여권발급 신청</option><option value="분실">여권 분실 신고</option></select><span class="hint">한국 여권 최초 발급이면 ‘여권발급 신청’을 선택하세요.</span></div></fieldset><fieldset><legend>법정대리인 1</legend><div class="field"><label for="f-p1_name">법정대리인 1 성명</label><input type="text" id="f-p1_name" data-field="p1_name" autocomplete="off" maxlength="40"></div><div class="field"><label for="f-p1_id">법정대리인 1 주민등록번호</label><input type="text" id="f-p1_id" data-field="p1_id" autocomplete="off" maxlength="14" placeholder="예: 123456-1234567" inputmode="text" pattern="[0-9]{6}-?[0-9]{7}"></div><div class="field"><label for="f-p1_address">법정대리인 1 주소</label><textarea id="f-p1_address" data-field="p1_address" autocomplete="off" maxlength="180" rows="2"></textarea></div><div class="field"><label for="f-p1_relation">자녀와의 관계</label><input type="text" id="f-p1_relation" data-field="p1_relation" autocomplete="off" maxlength="35" placeholder="예: 부 또는 모"></div></fieldset><fieldset><legend>법정대리인 2</legend><div class="field"><label for="f-p2_name">법정대리인 2 성명</label><input type="text" id="f-p2_name" data-field="p2_name" autocomplete="off" maxlength="40"></div><div class="field"><label for="f-p2_id">법정대리인 2 주민등록번호</label><input type="text" id="f-p2_id" data-field="p2_id" autocomplete="off" maxlength="14" placeholder="예: 123456-1234567" inputmode="text" pattern="[0-9]{6}-?[0-9]{7}"></div><div class="field"><label for="f-p2_address">법정대리인 2 주소</label><textarea id="f-p2_address" data-field="p2_address" autocomplete="off" maxlength="180" rows="2"></textarea></div><div class="field"><label for="f-p2_relation">자녀와의 관계</label><input type="text" id="f-p2_relation" data-field="p2_relation" autocomplete="off" maxlength="35" placeholder="예: 모 또는 부"></div></fieldset><fieldset><legend>동의서 작성일</legend><div class="field"><label for="f-signed_date">작성 날짜</label><input type="date" id="f-signed_date" data-field="signed_date" autocomplete="off"><span class="hint">하단 법정대리인 서명은 인쇄 후 검은색 펜으로 작성하세요.</span></div></fieldset></section><section class="doc-area"><div class="guide">원본 서식 위에 입력한 내용을 표시합니다. <b>PDF 다운로드</b>는 미리보기 화면에서도 작동하도록 별도로 만들었습니다. <b>인쇄하기</b>는 내려받은 HTML을 Chrome에서 직접 열어 사용하세요. 인쇄 시 <b>A4 · 컬러 · 실제 크기(100%) · 여백 없음</b>을 선택하세요. <b>서명은 인쇄 후 검은색 펜으로 직접</b> 하세요.</div><div class="paper-shell"><div class="paper"><img alt="법정대리인 동의서 원본 1페이지" src="data:image/png;base64,"><div class="overlay" id="editable-page"></div></div></div><div class="page-footer">이 문서는 원본 공식 서식 위에 입력 내용을 인쇄하기 위한 개인용 편집본입니다. 원본 안내사항을 확인하세요.</div></section></main>
<script>
const cfg = {"key": "법정대리인동의서", "sections": [{"name": "신청인 (여권 명의인 · 자녀)", "fields": [{"id": "child_name", "label": "자녀 성명", "max": 40}, {"id": "child_id", "label": "자녀 주민등록번호", "kind": "rrn", "max": 14, "placeholder": "예: 123456-1234567", "hint": "하이픈을 포함해 입력할 수 있습니다. 숫자만 입력해도 자동으로 하이픈이 붙습니다."}, {"id": "child_address", "label": "자녀 주소", "kind": "textarea", "max": 180, "placeholder": "미국 주소 포함 실제 주소를 기재"}]}, {"name": "동의 구분", "fields": [{"id": "consent_type", "label": "동의 내용", "kind": "select", "options": [["발급", "여권발급 신청"], ["분실", "여권 분실 신고"]], "hint": "한국 여권 최초 발급이면 ‘여권발급 신청’을 선택하세요."}]}, {"name": "법정대리인 1", "fields": [{"id": "p1_name", "label": "법정대리인 1 성명", "max": 40}, {"id": "p1_id", "label": "법정대리인 1 주민등록번호", "kind": "rrn", "max": 14, "placeholder": "예: 123456-1234567"}, {"id": "p1_address", "label": "법정대리인 1 주소", "kind": "textarea", "max": 180}, {"id": "p1_relation", "label": "자녀와의 관계", "max": 35, "placeholder": "예: 부 또는 모"}]}, {"name": "법정대리인 2", "fields": [{"id": "p2_name", "label": "법정대리인 2 성명", "max": 40}, {"id": "p2_id", "label": "법정대리인 2 주민등록번호", "kind": "rrn", "max": 14, "placeholder": "예: 123456-1234567"}, {"id": "p2_address", "label": "법정대리인 2 주소", "kind": "textarea", "max": 180}, {"id": "p2_relation", "label": "자녀와의 관계", "max": 35, "placeholder": "예: 모 또는 부"}]}, {"name": "동의서 작성일", "fields": [{"id": "signed_date", "label": "작성 날짜", "kind": "date", "hint": "하단 법정대리인 서명은 인쇄 후 검은색 펜으로 작성하세요."}]}], "overlays": [{"type": "line", "field": "child_name", "x": 208, "y": 261, "w": 310, "font": 15, "wrap": false}, {"type": "line", "field": "child_id", "x": 554, "y": 261, "w": 325, "font": 14, "wrap": false}, {"type": "line", "field": "child_address", "x": 207, "y": 315, "w": 660, "font": 14, "wrap": true}, {"type": "mark", "field": "consent_type", "mapping": {"발급": [222, 407], "분실": [222, 474]}}, {"type": "line", "field": "p1_name", "x": 208, "y": 552, "w": 309, "font": 15, "wrap": false}, {"type": "line", "field": "p1_id", "x": 554, "y": 552, "w": 325, "font": 14, "wrap": false}, {"type": "line", "field": "p1_address", "x": 207, "y": 614, "w": 326, "font": 13, "wrap": true}, {"type": "line", "field": "p1_relation", "x": 556, "y": 620, "w": 315, "font": 14, "wrap": false}, {"type": "line", "field": "p2_name", "x": 208, "y": 704, "w": 309, "font": 15, "wrap": false}, {"type": "line", "field": "p2_id", "x": 554, "y": 704, "w": 325, "font": 14, "wrap": false}, {"type": "line", "field": "p2_address", "x": 207, "y": 766, "w": 326, "font": 13, "wrap": true}, {"type": "line", "field": "p2_relation", "x": 556, "y": 774, "w": 315, "font": 14, "wrap": false}, {"type": "date", "field": "signed_date", "points": [[714, 920, 50], [782, 920, 30], [843, 920, 30]]}]};
const coords = { W:992, H:1403 };
const values = Object.create(null);

const clean = (field, value) => {
  let v = String(value ?? '');
  if(field.kind === 'digits') v = v.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  if(field.kind === 'rrn') {
    const digits = v.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '').slice(0,13);
    const separator = digits.length > 6 || (digits.length === 6 && v.includes('-'));
    v = digits.slice(0,6) + (separator ? '-' : '') + digits.slice(6);
  }
  if(field.kind === 'roman') v = v.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z \-]/g,'');
  if(field.max) v = [...v].slice(0, field.max).join('');
  return v;
};
const allFields = cfg.sections.flatMap(s => s.fields);
const fieldMap = Object.fromEntries(allFields.map(f => [f.id,f]));
for(const f of allFields) values[f.id] = '';
function el(tag,cls, parent){const o=document.createElement(tag);if(cls)o.className=cls;if(parent)parent.appendChild(o);return o}
function pct(x,n){ return (x/n*100).toFixed(5)+'%'; }
function draw(p,kind,x,y,txt,style={}){
 if(!txt) return;
 const e=el('span','page-fill '+kind,p);
 e.textContent=txt;
 e.style.left=pct(x,coords.W);e.style.top=pct(y,coords.H);
 if(style.width !== undefined) e.style.width=pct(style.width,coords.W);
 if(style.font) e.style.fontSize=style.font+'px';
 if(style.center) e.style.textAlign='center';
 if(style.wrap) e.classList.add('page-wrap');
 if(style.wrap) e.style.whiteSpace='pre-wrap';
 return e;
}
function drawGrid(p, value, r){
 // The passport form already prints a hyphen between the six- and seven-digit groups.
 // Do not let a typed hyphen consume one of its thirteen character cells.
 const valueForCells = fieldMap[r.field]?.kind === 'rrn'
   ? String(value||'').replace(/[^0-9]/g,'')
   : String(value||'').replace(/\s/g,'');
 const arr=[...valueForCells];
 for(let i=0;i<r.rects.length&&i<arr.length;i++){
   let [x,y,w,h]=r.rects[i];
   const font=r.font||14;
   draw(p,'page-char',x+w/2,y+h/2,arr[i],{font});
 }
}
function drawLine(p, value, r) {
 if(!value)return;
 let fs=r.font||13;
 // Preserve legibility in narrow original rows.
 if(!r.wrap && r.w && [...value].length * fs*.68 > r.w*.79) fs=Math.max(9,fs*r.w*.79/([...value].length*fs*.68));
 draw(p,'page-line',r.x,r.y,value,{font:fs,width:r.w,wrap:r.wrap});
}
function drawDate(p, iso, r){
 if(!iso || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(iso))return;
 const parts=[iso.slice(0,4),String(Number(iso.slice(5,7))),String(Number(iso.slice(8,10)))];
 r.points.forEach(([x,y,w],i) => draw(p,'page-line',x,y,parts[i],{font:12,width:w,center:true}));
}
function redraw(){
 const pane=document.querySelector('.overlay');
 pane.replaceChildren();
 for(const r of cfg.overlays){
   const v=values[r.field];
   if(!v)continue;
   if(r.type==='mark'){
     const pos=r.mapping[v];if(pos)draw(pane,'page-mark',pos[0],pos[1],'✔',{font:13});
   } else if(r.type==='cells')drawGrid(pane,v,r);
   else if(r.type==='line')drawLine(pane,v,r);
   else if(r.type==='date')drawDate(pane,v,r);
 }
}
function initControls(){
 for(const input of document.querySelectorAll('[data-field]')){
   const f=fieldMap[input.dataset.field];
   input.addEventListener('input',()=>{
     const v=clean(f,input.value);
     if(v!==input.value)input.value=v;
     values[f.id]=v;redraw();
   });
 }
}
function syncControls(){for(const f of allFields){const e=document.querySelector('[data-field="'+f.id+'"]');if(e)e.value=values[f.id]||''}redraw()}
function downloadJSON(){
 const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify({document:cfg.key, savedAt:new Date().toISOString(), values:{...values}},null,2)],{type:'application/json;charset=utf-8'});
 const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=cfg.key+'-작성내용.json';document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1200);
}
function loadJSON(input){
 const file=input.files&&input.files[0];if(!file)return;
 file.text().then(t=>{
   const doc=JSON.parse(t);
   if(doc.document!==cfg.key || !doc.values || typeof doc.values!=='object')throw Error('이 서식용으로 저장된 JSON 파일이 아닙니다.');
   for(const f of allFields)values[f.id]=clean(f,doc.values[f.id]);
   syncControls();alert('작성 내용을 불러왔습니다.');
 }).catch(e=>alert('불러오기 실패: '+e.message)).finally(()=>input.value='');
}
function clearValues(){if(!confirm('모든 입력 내용을 지울까요?'))return;for(const f of allFields)values[f.id]='';syncControls()}
// Print popups are frequently blocked in embedded HTML viewers. In this case
// provide a PDF file with the original form instead of silently doing nothing.
function setStatus(message,isError=false){
 const box=document.getElementById('actionStatus');
 if(box){box.textContent=message;box.style.color=isError?'#a3171d':'#28603c';}
}
function doPrint(){
 if(window.top !== window.self){
   setStatus('미리보기 창에서는 인쇄 대화상자가 차단될 수 있어 PDF 파일로 저장합니다. 저장된 PDF를 열어 인쇄하세요.');
   exportPDF();
   return;
 }
 setStatus('인쇄 대화상자가 열리지 않으면 Ctrl+P를 누르거나 PDF 다운로드를 사용하세요.');
 try { window.print(); }
 catch(err){setStatus('인쇄 창을 열 수 없어 PDF 파일로 저장합니다.');exportPDF();}
}

// Fully offline, dependency-free PDF download. Render each official form page
// and the filled text on an HTML canvas, JPEG-compress it and package as A4 PDF.
// This works even if window.print() is blocked by an embedded preview frame.
function pdfFromJpegs(pages){
 const encoder=new TextEncoder();const chunks=[];const offsets=[];let length=0;
 function bytes(b){chunks.push(b);length+=b.length;}
 function str(s){bytes(encoder.encode(s));}
 function openObj(id){offsets[id]=length;str(id+' 0 obj\n');}
 function closeObj(){str('endobj\n');}
 const count=2+3*pages.length;
 str('%PDF-1.4\n%PDF Generated locally\n');
 openObj(1);str('<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\n');closeObj();
 openObj(2);
 str('<< /Type /Pages /Count '+pages.length+' /Kids ['+pages.map((_,i)=>(3+i*3)+' 0 R').join(' ') + '] >>\n');closeObj();
 for(let i=0;i<pages.length;i++){
   const p=pages[i], page=3+3*i, contents=page+1, img=page+2;
   openObj(page);
   str('<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 595.276 841.89] /Resources << /XObject << /FormImage'+i+' '+img+' 0 R >> >> /Contents '+contents+' 0 R >>\n');closeObj();
   const draw='q\n595.276 0 0 841.89 0 0 cm\n/FormImage'+i+' Do\nQ\n';
   openObj(contents);str('<< /Length '+encoder.encode(draw).length+' >>\nstream\n'+draw+'endstream\n');closeObj();
   openObj(img);
   str('<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width '+p.width+' /Height '+p.height+' /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length '+p.jpeg.length+' >>\nstream\n');
   bytes(p.jpeg);str('\nendstream\n');closeObj();
 }
 const xref=length;
 str('xref\n0 '+(count+1)+'\n0000000000 65535 f \n');
 for(let i=1;i<=count;i++)str(String(offsets[i]).padStart(10,'0')+' 00000 n \n');
 str('trailer\n<< /Size '+(count+1)+' /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n'+xref+'\n%%EOF\n');
 return new Blob(chunks,{type:'application/pdf'});
}
function jpegBytes(canvas){
 const base64=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.96).split(',')[1];
 const raw=atob(base64);const data=new Uint8Array(raw.length);
 for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)data[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);
 return data;
}
function stampOverlay(ctx){
 const xFactor=coords.W/794;
 const fontFamily='"Malgun Gothic", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans CJK KR", Arial, sans-serif';
 ctx.fillStyle='#111111';
 function write(text,x,y,px,align='left',weight=500,baseline='middle',maxWidth=null){
   if(!text)return;
   ctx.font=weight+' '+(px*xFactor)+'px '+fontFamily;
   ctx.textAlign=align;ctx.textBaseline=baseline;
   if(maxWidth)ctx.fillText(text,x,y,maxWidth); else ctx.fillText(text,x,y);
 }
 for(const r of cfg.overlays){
   const raw=values[r.field];if(!raw)continue;
   if(r.type==='mark'){
     const pos=r.mapping[raw];if(pos)write('✔',pos[0],pos[1],13,'center',750);
   } else if(r.type==='cells'){
     const text=fieldMap[r.field]?.kind==='rrn'?String(raw).replace(/[^0-9]/g,''):String(raw).replace(/\s/g,'');
     for(const [i,rect] of r.rects.entries()){
       if(i>=[...text].length)break;
       const [x,y,w,h]=rect;write([...text][i],x+w/2,y+h/2,r.font||14,'center');
     }
   } else if(r.type==='line'){
     let fs=r.font||13;
     if(!r.wrap&&r.w&&[...raw].length*fs*.68>r.w*.79)fs=Math.max(9,fs*r.w*.79/([...raw].length*fs*.68));
     if(r.wrap){
       ctx.font='500 '+(fs*xFactor)+'px '+fontFamily;
       const lineHeight=fs*xFactor*1.32;let yy=r.y+lineHeight*.45;
       const chunks=String(raw).split('\n');
       for(const chunk of chunks){
         let line='';
         for(const ch of chunk){
           if(line&&ctx.measureText(line+ch).width>r.w){write(line,r.x,yy,fs);yy+=lineHeight;line='';}
           line+=ch;
         }
         if(line)write(line,r.x,yy,fs);
         yy+=lineHeight;
       }
     }else{write(String(raw),r.x,r.y,fs,'left',500,'middle',r.w);}
   } else if(r.type==='date'){
     const iso=String(raw);if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(iso))continue;
     const parts=[iso.slice(0,4),String(Number(iso.slice(5,7))),String(Number(iso.slice(8,10)))];
     r.points.forEach(([x,y,w],i)=>write(parts[i],x+w/2,y,12,'center'));
   }
 }
}
async function exportPDF(){
 const button=document.getElementById('downloadPdfButton');
 if(button?.disabled)return;
 const original=button?.textContent;
 try{
   if(button){button.disabled=true;button.textContent='PDF 만드는 중…';}
   setStatus('PDF 생성 중입니다. 잠시 기다려 주세요.');
   const papers=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.paper'));
   const pages=[];
   for(let i=0;i<papers.length;i++){
     const img=papers[i].querySelector('img');
     if(!img?.complete || img.naturalWidth===0)await img.decode();
     const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=img.naturalWidth;canvas.height=img.naturalHeight;
     const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});if(!ctx)throw Error('캔버스를 만들지 못했습니다.');
     ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
     ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
     ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
     if(i===0){ctx.save();ctx.scale(canvas.width/coords.W,canvas.height/coords.H);stampOverlay(ctx);ctx.restore();}
     pages.push({width:canvas.width,height:canvas.height,jpeg:jpegBytes(canvas)});
     canvas.width=0;canvas.height=0;
   }
   const blob=pdfFromJpegs(pages),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download=cfg.key+'_작성본.pdf';
   document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();
   setStatus('PDF를 만들었습니다. 다운로드된 PDF를 열어 A4 컬러로 인쇄하세요. 다운로드가 차단되면 이 HTML을 Chrome에서 직접 열어 사용하세요.');
   setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),60000);
 }catch(e){
   console.error('PDF 생성 오류:',e);
   setStatus('PDF 생성 오류: '+e.message+' — HTML을 Chrome에서 열고 Ctrl+P로 인쇄해 주세요.',true);
 }finally{if(button){button.disabled=false;button.textContent=original;}}
}
function resize(){for(const shell of document.querySelectorAll('.paper-shell')){const paper=shell.querySelector('.paper');paper.style.setProperty('--scale',String(shell.clientWidth/794));}}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{initControls();redraw();resize();});
</script></body></html>
